ConnectionStrings._comment: Placeholder only. Use the Session pooler string from Supabase (Settings > Database > Connection pooling) - the direct db.<ref>.supabase.co host is IPv6-only and unreachable from most networks. Set the real value via `dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection" "..."` locally, or an env var (ConnectionStrings__DefaultConnection) in hosting. See CLAUDE.md.

Jwt._comment: Placeholder only. Set the real signing key via `dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:Key" "..."` locally, or an env var (Jwt__Key) in hosting. See CLAUDE.md.
Jwt._expiryComment: 30 days. Mobile clients have no refresh-token flow, so a short-lived token forced a re-sign-in every hour; the app also treats an expired/invalid token as signed-out (401 -> re-auth), so this only sets how long a session lasts before that kicks in.

Subscription._comment: Trial + paid-plan config. TrialMinutes is the free-trial length (2880 = 2 days). PlanDays is how long one activation code / payment grants.

GoogleAuth._comment: OAuth client IDs are not secret (unlike client secrets), so the real values can live here. List every platform client ID that can end up as the ID token's 'aud' claim: Android (via serverClientId) issues tokens audienced to the Web client, but iOS issues tokens audienced to its own GIDClientID even when serverClientId is also set - so both must be trusted here. See CLAUDE.md.
